object: feature; paired target-position response changes in a native single-layer SAE
observation_unit: base case containing <=4 controlled prefix variants
independence_unit: source_group; average response rows within any shared source_group before primary relation statistics; resample source_group blocks, never variant sequences
raw_contribution: a_f=z_f*L2(actual decoder column f), in native hook units; magnitude is not additive explained variance
normalized_readout: a_f/L2(h), stored separately; ratio changes cannot replace absolute changes
main_contrast: changed-base for A/B; near_changed-near_base for C
discovery_scale: feature RMS raw contribution over all discovery cases/versions, floor1e-8; fixed on holdout

candidate_eligibility.ranking: mean absolute main delta across independent source groups / discovery scale; descending; feature ID ascending ties

stable_pool: all features with discovery activation case and independent-group support>=6, regardless of response support; freeze before holdout
global_amplitude_control: discovery OLS of per-feature main delta/discovery scale on intercept, delta log total raw contribution across all features, delta log hook norm; fit on source_group means; freeze coefficients and apply unchanged to holdout
main_relation: Pearson correlation between source_group mean controlled main-response vectors

clustering.degenerate_or_missing_correlation: NA; never zero; variance-ineligible discovery features excluded before clustering
clustering.bootstrap_procedure: resample independent source-group response rows; fixed candidate features, scales, coefficients, average linkage and cut; zero-variance sampled features assigned singleton
clustering.group_stability: mean bootstrap coassignment proportion across original within-group feature pairs

H1.direction: sign of discovery mean raw semantic delta within each panel(A/B) x target-token stratum; no holdout fitting
H1.effect: mean(direction*raw semantic delta - absolute neutral control)/discovery scale; average within source_group first
H1.p: 9999 one-sided independent source-group sign flips on semantic delta only; neutral control fixed; signflip p tests directionality and bootstrap CI separately requires benefit above neutral edits
H1.multiplicity: BH FDR0.05 across all frozen candidates
H1.support: activation support>=6 independent holdout groups; >=3 holdout template families; direction agreement>=2/3; BH q<=.05; two-sided95%bootstrap lower bound of excess>0; every leave-one-template-family-out excess positive; largest case absolute-excess share<.35
H1.otherwise: INSUFFICIENT; no failure-to-reject interpretation as invariance
H1.direction_agreement_denominator: independent holdout source groups with nonzero semantic response and nonzero frozen discovery direction; at least6; total-group denominator separately reported

H2.effect: mean pairwise holdout controlled response correlation in each frozen discovery group
H2.eligibility: each member>=6 holdout independent activation-support groups; group response in>=6 independent groups; each feature pair has any nonzero raw response in>=4 independent groups; finite nonzero variance for every member

random_groups.pool: all discovery-eligible features except current group members
random_groups.standardization: one SD per dimension across discovery eligible pool; floor1e-8
random_groups.fixed_caliper: absolute standardized difference<=1 in every dimension
random_groups.candidate_pool_per_member: nearest20 by squared standardized distance; no caliper relaxation
random_groups.sampling: one match per member without replacement within group; random choice among available nearest20

H2.marginal_null: 1000 independent feature-wise permutations of source_group response rows; exact marginal values and nonzero support retained
H2.multiplicity: separate BH FDR0.05 across frozen groups for random-group and marginal-permutation p-values
H2.support: discovery stability>=.70; eligible; matching qualified; both BH q<=.05; mean holdout correlation>0;95%case-group bootstrap CI lower>0; every leave-one-template-family-out holdout group correlation>0
H2.weakened: eligible and matching-qualified but frozen support criteria fail
H2.frequency_boundary: existing independent E17 DCLM TRAIN discovery frequencies; historical backbone weight digest absent; frequency-matched interpretation conditional on original parent identity; E17 SAE inference used BF16 autocast versus current FP32; near-tie TopK supports may differ, adding a conditional precision boundary

H3.effect: (far_changed-far_base)-(near_changed-near_base), raw contribution; report pure base near/far separately
H3.direction: sign of discovery mean interaction per frozen candidate
H3.eligibility: same target token, total token length and target position; same clue content retained on relocation; >=6 independent C holdout support groups and >=6 nonzero interaction groups
H3.test: 9999 one-sided source-group sign flips; BH0.05 across frozen candidates;95%bootstrap lower bound>0; direction agreement>=2/3
H3.support_wording: distance/order sensitivity under this specific neutral-content relocation
H3.boundary: word order and clue distance vary jointly; no exclusive long-range feature, layer generation chain or causal information propagation claim
H3.direction_agreement_denominator: independent C holdout source groups with nonzero interaction and nonzero frozen discovery direction; at least6; total-group denominator separately reported

equivalence.holdout_support: >=6 independent source groups with nonzero activation
equivalence.mean_raw_delta_CI: 90%source-group bootstrap CI entirely within +/-0.2 discovery RMS
equivalence.absolute_raw_delta: one-sided95%upper bound(mean absolute main delta/discovery RMS)<=0.2; retain within-group mean absolute deltas before block average
equivalence.scope: operationally stable for the registered contrasts; not universally context invariant

figure1.feature_ids: first8 variance-eligible discovery candidates in frozen rank order
figure1.color_scale: same raw z scale for every before/after panel

figure2.data: discovery and holdout controlled response correlation; frozen discovery tree order
figure2.annotations: feature IDs, independent reference frequency, case/source support, response description, holdout group replication

figure3.condition: model-independent C token-position/length and semantic-clue qualification passes
figure3.data: near/far paired raw semantic contrasts; first8 frozen candidates

selection_and_unsealing: discovery command never opens holdout response files; write hashes, candidate IDs, stable pool, scales, coefficients, tree, groups and plot list before evaluate opens holdout
authority: user authorized implementation choices and direct bounded execution; algorithmic SUPPORT/WEAKENED/INSUFFICIENT is AI interpretation under these fixed criteria, not researcher scientific acceptance
counterexample_selection: first candidate in frozen discovery ranking failing H1; illustrate its maximum-absolute-discovery-delta case; single case cannot prove population stability
